paragraphs.text: Because of God's promise made to the people of Israel.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Elpalet and Nogah are not mentioned in 2Sa 5:14, so there are only eleven and here thirteen.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That is, the valley of divisions, because the enemies were dispersed there like waters.
paragraphs.label: c
